mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cargo_snapshot ( tracking_number, booking_id, origin_unlocode, destination_unlocode, cargo_type, projected_at, last_event_id ) VALUES ( #{trackingNumber}, #{bookingId}, #{originUnlocode}, #{destinationUnlocode}, #{cargoType}, #{projectedAt}, #{lastEventId} ) ON CONFLICT (tracking_number) DO UPDATE SET booking_id = EXCLUDED.booking_id, origin_unlocode = EXCLUDED.origin_unlocode, destination_unlocode = EXCLUDED.destination_unlocode, cargo_type = EXCLUDED.cargo_type, projected_at = EXCLUDED.projected_at, last_event_id = EXCLUDED.last_event_id

INSERT INTO cargo_snapshot_leg ( tracking_number, leg_seq, voyage_number, load_unlocode, unload_unlocode ) VALUES
(#{trackingNumber}, #{leg.legSeq}, #{leg.voyageNumber}, #{leg.loadUnlocode}, #{leg.unloadUnlocode})
